read.thesis: Prologis sees logistics supply tightening as replacement-cost rents sit 27% above market, with occupancy 95.6% and cash same-store NOI guided up to 7.0–7.5%; capital markets softening and rate-driven caution on starts.

utilisation.quote: We ended the quarter with 95.6% occupancy, up 10 basis points from the second quarter

capex.quote: we expect fewer starts and a more favorable supply environment

triggers.label: Replacement-cost rents 27% above market
triggers.quote: the rents needed to justify new construction have expanded to 27% above current market levels

triggers.label: Net effective rent change 38%
triggers.quote: Rent change on rollover was 38% on a net effective basis

triggers.label: US net absorption 63m sq ft in Q3
triggers.quote: U.S. net absorption totaled 63 million square feet in the third quarter

triggers.label: Cash same-store NOI guide raised to 7.0–7.5%
triggers.quote: Our strong year-to-date performance in same-store growth is driving an increase to its range

triggers.label: Disposition/contribution guide cut to caution
triggers.quote: reflects a little bit of caution and our willingness to be careful if there is some turbulence in pricing from here

guidance.quote: we are narrowing our forecast for average occupancy to a range of 95.25% to 95.50%
driving an increase to its range to 5.5% to 6% on a net effective basis and 7% to 7.5% on a cash basis
we are increasing development starts on an owned and managed basis to a range of $6 billion to $6.75 billion
Strategic capital revenue, excluding promotes, is being revised to a range of $650 million to $660 million
G&A is now expected to range between $515 million to $525 million
core FFO is expected to range between $6.25 and $6.29 per share, both with and without promotes
We're increasing our acquisitions guidance to $2.1 billion to $2.3 billion

red_flags.label: Transaction market slowing; bid-ask widening
red_flags.quote: we are observing a wider bid-ask spread

red_flags.label: Construction costs escalating, financing dearer
red_flags.quote: Construction costs are escalating, financing is more expensive and return requirements are trending higher

evasions.quote: So is that the exact number on where values are shaking out today? Hard to say.

evasions.topic: Data center funding and SEGRO accretion
evasions.quote: all of that regulated process does keep us from speaking with any specificity
